power.method: Supplied power adapter (Wi-Fi does not carry power)

features: two 2MP sensors with two 4mm lenses for a 180-degree view
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states two 2MP sensors (4MP combined, explicitly not a single 4MP stream), two 4 mm lenses, a 180-degree view (axis not stated), Wi-Fi, ABS IP66 housing, microphone and speaker, microSD up to 128GB and ONVIF support. Typed panoramic: two fixed lenses combined into one wide view (not a zoom dual-lens). The page names no app, so cloud_dependency is omitted; RTSP is not stated and no manual is linked, so only an ONVIF config is given. Night-vision type, sensor model, frame rate and dimensions are not published.

frigate.notes: No RTSP path published; discover via ONVIF.

home_assistant.notes: The product page lists ONVIF support; the ONVIF port is not published.
